references.text: The same curse for disobedience: the sky becomes like bronze and the earth like iron, so that crops fail
Describes how work in the fields and with trees will be futile as punishment for disobedience
Isaiah prophesies about vineyards yielding minimal harvests as a sign of God's judgment
Hosea describes how they shall sow but not reap as a result of their sin
Amos prophesies about how God withheld rain and destroyed the crops
Haggai describes how they sow much but reap little because the people neglect God's house
Haggai reminds them of the time when crops failed due to the people's disobedience
The psalmist emphasizes that without the Lord's blessing, all work is in vain
The contrast: the blessing of obedience includes that the land yields its produce and the trees their fruit
